characters.name: KASS MIISU
characters.description: Väike valge kass suurte roheliste silmadega, kandmas helekollast villast kampsunit, armas ja rõõmsameelne ilme. Multifilmistiil.

characters.name: KOER KUSTI
characters.description: Väike pruun koer lottis kõrvadega, kandmas siniseid traksipükse, uudishimulik ja sõbralik ilme. Multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Sügisene koduterrass
locations.description: Cozy wooden porch on a sunny autumn day, warm yellow wooden floor, small wooden craft table in the center, two small wooden chairs, colorful autumn trees with orange and red leaves visible in the background, warm sunlight streaming in. Simple clean cartoon style.

pages.scene: Kass Miisu in a light yellow sweater and Koer Kusti in blue overalls are standing together on a cozy sunny wooden porch. In the background, colorful autumn trees with red and orange leaves are visible. Miisu and Kusti are smiling cheerfully at each other.

Kass Miisu and Koer Kusti are kneeling near an autumn tree next to the wooden porch, picking up large brown pinecones from the ground covered in yellow leaves. Miisu holds a large pinecone in her hands and smiles.
Koer Kusti in blue overalls carries a small basket full of pinecones and places it on the wooden craft table on the porch. Kass Miisu stands next to the wooden table, clapping her hands excitedly.
Kass Miisu sits on a small wooden chair at the craft table on the porch, carefully gluing two small craft eyes onto a large pinecone. Koer Kusti leans on the table, watching with a curious smile.
Koer Kusti sits at the wooden table on the porch, carefully attaching a small orange yarn tail to the pinecone that now has tiny eyes. Kass Miisu sits next to him and smiles brightly.

On the wooden craft table on the sunny porch, a cute handcrafted pinecone fox figure with craft eyes and an orange yarn tail stands proudly. Kass Miisu and Koer Kusti look at the cute pinecone animal with happy expressions.

Kass Miisu and Koer Kusti are sitting together at the wooden table on the sunny porch, busy crafting more pinecone creatures. Five colorful pinecone animals with clay ears and yarn tails are now sitting in a neat row on the table.

Kass Miisu and Koer Kusti gently hold and move the little pinecone animals on the wooden craft table, playing a fun game together. Warm autumn sunlight glows on the porch, creating a happy and peaceful scene.
